title: chore: add patch changeset for listViews fix
body:
Adds a patch changeset covering the console fix from #532 where `defineStack()` Zod parsing stripped `listViews` from object metadata, causing calendar views to fall back to grid.

- **Changeset**: `.changeset/fix-calendar-listviews.md` — `@object-ui/console: patch`
- All 44 fixed-group packages will bump together (3.0.2 → 3.0.3) on version consume
